articles.title: ENHYPEN’s “THE SIN : VANISH” Spends 10th Week On Billboard 200 + Remains In Top 10 Of Album Sales Chart
articles.description: ENHYPEN’s latest mini album is a stable hit on the Billboard 200! Back in January, ENHYPEN’s “THE SIN : VANISH” debuted at No. 2 on Billboard’s Top 200 Albums chart, tying the group’s personal record for their highest-ranking album to date. articles.summary: ENHYPEN's mini album "THE SIN : VANISH" has spent its 10th consecutive week on the Billboard 200 chart and remains in the top 10 of the album sales chart. The album debuted at No. 2 in January, tying the group's personal record for highest-ranking album.

articles.title: CORTIS Smashes Own Record With Over 1.2 Million Stock Pre-Orders For “GREENGREEN”
articles.description: CORTIS is getting ready to soar to new heights with their first-ever comeback! On April 4, CORTIS’s album distributors YG PLUS and Universal Records announced that as of April 2, the rookie boy group’s upcoming mini album “GREENGREEN” had recorded a total of 1,227,986 stock pre-orders. articles.summary: K-pop rookie boy group CORTIS has achieved over 1.2 million stock pre-orders for their upcoming mini album "GREENGREEN," breaking their own previous record. The pre-order numbers were announced by distributors YG PLUS and Universal Records on April 4.
